<script>
(function () {
  var wrap = document.querySelector("[data-hero-demos]");
  if (!wrap) return;
  var tabs = wrap.querySelectorAll("[role=tab]");
  var panels = wrap.querySelectorAll("[role=tabpanel]");
  // One way out to the full widget, outside the frames, so it sits in the
  // same place whichever tab is open; it follows the tab.
  var open = wrap.querySelector("[data-hero-open]");
  // A hidden iframe is not lazy-loaded: a browser treats one as a tracking
  // pixel and fetches it anyway, whatever `loading` says. So every panel
  // carries its URL in data-src and is handed it only when it is really on
  // screen -- the open tab, and not at all where homepage.scss replaces the
  // whole row with the static diagram, which is the reader least able to
  // spare three widgets.
  var diagram = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (max-width: 540px)");
  function load(panel) {
    var frame = panel && panel.querySelector("iframe[data-src]");
    if (!frame || diagram.matches) return;
    // Once: assigning src again on a later visit to the tab would reload the
    // widget and throw away what the reader had set up in it.
    frame.src = frame.getAttribute("data-src");
    frame.removeAttribute("data-src");
  }
  function show(i) {
    tabs.forEach(function (tab, j) {
      var on = i === j;
      tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
      tab.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
      panels[j].hidden = !on;
      if (on) {
        load(panels[j]);
        open.href = panels[j].getAttribute("data-open");
      }
    });
  }
  tabs.forEach(function (tab, i) {
    tab.addEventListener("click", function () { show(i); });
    tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      var k = e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0;
      if (!k) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var n = (i + k + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
      show(n);
      tabs[n].focus();
    });
  });
  // The open tab: now, or whenever a resize or a changed motion preference
  // first puts the demos on screen.
  diagram.addEventListener("change", function () {
    load(wrap.querySelector("[role=tabpanel]:not([hidden])"));
  });
  load(panels[0]);
  wrap.parentElement.classList.add("has-js");
})();
</script>

## Pruébalos en el navegador {#interactive}

<span data-language-key="try-one-in-the-browser"></span>

Sin instalar nada y sin cuenta. Escribe dos formas y mira cómo NumPy las alinea;
convierte tres fotografías en cubos y rompe la imagen con un reshape; recorre una
secuencia a través de la atención, una contracción cada vez; observa cómo una
circunferencia se vuelve una elipse; u oye qué le hace una transposición a una
grabación.

## ¿Conoces el álgebra lineal básica? Ya puedes empezar. {#requisitos-previos}

<span data-language-key="familiar-with-basic-linear-algebra-you-re-ready-to-go"></span>

:::: {.prerequisite-list}

### Paso 1: Conceptos básicos [Obligatorio]{.step-badge}
